deadline.value: Physics application deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 18, 2026.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 entry is December 18, 2026.

gre_general.value: For Fall 2027 the Graduate School application does not require the GRE General.
gre_general.quote: For Fall 2027, the Graduate School application does not require the GRE General Test scores.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject Test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: The Physics GRE Subject Test is optional.

toefl_min.value: Physics says the TOEFL is optional and gives no minimum score.

supervisor.value: The physics pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Physics PhD students get a 12-month stipend plus full tuition coverage and health insurance.
funding.quote: Graduate students receive comprehensive funding, including a competitive stipend ($43,260 for 12 months) plus full tuition coverage

also.quote: Graduate students in Physics are supported by a 12-month stipend during their graduate study

entry_route.value: The department assumes an entering student has an undergraduate physics programme equal to an Emory physics bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: It is assumed that the entering physics graduate student has completed an undergraduate program which is equivalent to that of a student who obtained the Bachelor's degree in physics at Emory.

notes: Department states TOEFL optional and GRE General not required for Fall 2027. No supervisor rule found on the physics pages.
